method: Original high-resolution sheets were downloaded and manually transcribed, then visually checked. OCR was not accepted as final text.
normalization: Wave-dash variants are consistently U+301C (〜) to avoid visually identical but byte-distinct quiz choices.
Parentheses in Japanese glosses use fullwidth forms.
Numbering, order, headwords, meanings, source spelling and missing terminal punctuation are otherwise preserved.
attachmentCompleteness: User provided pages1-4and6-8; missing201-250was read from page5 of the same linked original collection.

sourceQuirks.note: Printed source includes 子; kept without guessing a replacement.
